'''Kindin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked with [[Xo'ru]]. The two of them accepted [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher's]] bounty on a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />

==Biography==
Around [[3643 BBY]], during the time of the [[Separatist War|civil war on Ord Mantell]], Kindin and Xo'ru were sent by Rogun to capture and bring back a [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] due to believing [[Voidhound|them]] to have stolen a shipment of weapons, which was supposed to have been delivered to the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]].<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />

When the smuggler, accompanied by [[Corso Riggs]], arrived at the docking bay in [[Drelliad village]], Kindin and Xo'ru confronted them. Unwilling to convince the smuggler to come with them, the two groups got into a fight in which both Kindin and Xo'ru were killed.<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />
